entries.reason: reverseSettlementForVoid() flips driver_settlements to status='cancelled'+voided_at directly (R-102-B). Since LEAD 443.192 (2026-10-17) it runs the shared driver-settlement void cascade completeDriverSettlementVoidCascadeInClientTx (lines voided, open driver bills + unpaid reimbursements released) with voidChildren:false ON PURPOSE: the only stamped child is driver_settlement_deductions.voided_at, and on this path (Settlement Creator Edit / POST /reverse) deductions go only through the owner-ruled three-branch deduction engine (reverseDeductionForVoid -> voidSettlementDeduction, 'why would I forgive the debt') or are restored to pending by the GL reversal; a raw voided_at stamp would forgive an uncollected deduction. Kept in the baseline with this reason, not wired.
